title: Hitting-time bound for adjacent vertices
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree $D$, and let $u,v$ be adjacent vertices. For every natural number $N$, the cumulative miss probability for hitting $v$ from $u$ through step $N-1$ is at most $D(|V|-1)$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular multigraph of positive degree $D$
